name: workspace
help:
usage: work workspace [-h] {create} ...

positional arguments:
  {create}
    create    Allocate a current transaction workspace.

options:
  -h, --help  Return command help in a JSON response.

children.name: create
children.help:
usage: work workspace create [-h] [--requirement-id REQUIREMENT_ID]
                                --workflow-id WORKFLOW_ID

Allocate outputs/work/transactions with inputs, requests, responses and envelopes.
Use returned data.paths and preserve every allocated workspace.

options:
  -h, --help            Return command help in a JSON response.
  --requirement-id REQUIREMENT_ID
  --workflow-id WORKFLOW_ID
